newsitem.title: USA: National Picture to be bought for $12/shr.
newsitem.headline: National Picture to be bought for $12/shr.

text.p: National Picture & Frame Co, a maker of picture frames, framed mirrors and framed art, said Friday it had signed a letter of intent to be acquired by the Richmond, Va.-based private equity firm Colonnade Capital LLC for $12 cash per share.

National, which sells its products through big retailers like Wal-Mart and Target, said the acquisition is contingent on certain conditions, including Colonnade's due diligence review and empolyment arrangements with National's senior management.
If the conditions are met, National said it would enter a definitive agreement with Colonnade.
National said it hopes such an agreement can be reached within the next 60 to 90 days.
National said it had agreed not to enter acquisition talks with other companies and had agreed to pay Colonnade a $2.5 million breakup fee if it terminates the letter of intent.
Officials from National were not available to comment further.
